# Suggested changes: parsing, server rule and fixer instruction

## What to build

A reviewer can put a GitHub-style suggestion in a comment body. A suggestion is a fenced block with the info string `suggestion`:

````
Use a capped limit.

```suggestion
const limit = Math.min(Number(q.limit) || 20, 50);
```
````

It means "replace exactly the commented lines with this text". This slice adds the backend half:

- a pure `parseSuggestion(body)` in `src/review/human.ts`
- a store rule: a suggestion is only allowed on a comment with `side: "new"` and a line range. Otherwise the store throws `HumanReviewError("suggestion needs side new")` → HTTP 400 on both servers.
- the fixer prompt tells the fixer to apply the suggestion verbatim
- the code reviewer prompt tells the reviewer to check that the lines now match the suggestion

The previous slice already gave comments `side`, `startLine` and `endLine` (normalized from the legacy `line`). It also added `rangeLabel(c)` in `src/review/human.ts`, and a shared location helper used by `humanSection` in `src/agents/fixer.ts` and by the human-comments block of `src/agents/reviewer.ts`. There is no new field: the suggestion lives in `body`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/review/human.ts`: `commentSchema` (with `side`/`startLine`/`endLine`) and `HumanReviewStore.add` / `edit`. Both must enforce the rule, because `edit` can change the body.
- `src/agents/fixer.ts` (about lines 75–90): `humanSection`. Each comment renders as a `- **human-H1-1** \`file\` new lines 12–18: body` line, plus `  Code: <fenced snippet>`.
- `src/agents/fixer.ts` (about lines 139–146): the per-comment commit-message and notes-file instructions, where the general suggestion rule goes.
- `src/agents/reviewer.ts` (about lines 127–139): the human comments block of `codeReviewerPrompt`.
- `src/web/server.ts` `commentWrite` / `commentRoute` (about lines 277–315) and `src/suite/server.ts` `commentWrite` (about 117–140). `HumanReviewError` with kind `invalid` maps to 400 there, so no server code change should be needed. Verify this with a test.
- `src/review/human.test.ts` and `src/review/phase.test.ts` (around 967–988): the test patterns.

## Patterns to follow

**Pure parser:**
```ts
/** The replacement text of the first ```suggestion block, or undefined. An empty block means "delete these lines" (""). */
export function parseSuggestion(body: string): string | undefined {
  const m = /^```suggestion[ \t]*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)^```[ \t]*$/m.exec(body);
  if (!m) return undefined;
  return m[1]!.replace(/\r?\n$/, "");
}
```
Handle the block at the very start or end of the body, CRLF line endings, an empty block (`""`), and an unclosed fence (→ `undefined`).

**Error:** `throw new HumanReviewError("suggestion needs side new")`. Throw it inside the `serial()` callback, as the existing checks do.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/review/human.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: export `parseSuggestion`. In `add`, after parsing, if `parseSuggestion(body) !== undefined` and (`side !== "new"` or `startLine === undefined`), throw `HumanReviewError("suggestion needs side new")`. Apply the same check in `edit` against the stored comment's side and range.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review/human`

### UPDATE `src/agents/fixer.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `humanSection`, for a comment whose body has a suggestion, push the line `  Suggested replacement for these lines (apply it exactly unless that breaks the build; if you deviate, say why in your note):` followed by `fence(suggestion)`. When at least one comment has a suggestion, add a general rule line after the per-comment commit-message instruction: `- A suggested replacement replaces exactly the commented lines (new side), nothing more.`
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/agents/reviewer.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: for a comment with a suggestion, push `  Suggested replacement (addressed only if the code at these lines now matches it, or the fixer's note explains a better equivalent):` and `fence(suggestion)`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE tests

- `src/review/human.test.ts`:
  - `parseSuggestion` cases: none, simple, CRLF, empty block, unclosed fence, block in the middle of text
  - `add` with a suggestion on `side:"old"` → throws `suggestion needs side new`
  - a file-only comment with a suggestion → throws
  - `edit` that adds a suggestion to an old-side comment → throws
- `src/web/server.test.ts` and `src/suite/server.test.ts`: POST an old-side comment with a suggestion body → 400 `{error: "suggestion needs side new"}` (match the existing error JSON shape used by `commentWrite`). A new-side one → 201.
- `src/review/phase.test.ts`: a request-changes round with a suggestion comment. The fixer prompt contains `Suggested replacement for these lines` and the suggestion text.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review src/web/server src/suite/server`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `parseSuggestion` returns the block text, `""` for an empty block, and `undefined` for no block or an unclosed one
- [ ] `POST /review/comments` (and `/api/review/comments`) with a suggestion on `side:"old"`, or with no line range → 400 `suggestion needs side new`
- [ ] `PUT /review/comments/:id` that adds a suggestion to an old-side comment → 400
- [ ] The fixer prompt lists the suggestion under its comment with the "apply it exactly" instruction, plus the general rule line
- [ ] The code reviewer prompt lists the suggestion with the "addressed only if it matches" rule
- [ ] `npm test` passes

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/review src/agents src/web/server src/suite/server
```
